name: Unasked items are taken and useful
purpose: An offered item is useful often enough that it is kept, and nothing is offered when nothing bears on the request.
record: Twenty invented neutral cases (evaluation/intuition/build_cases.py, source tag invented-neutral), five domains of four kinds: wording (the useful card shares words with the request), companion (it shares none but was taken for a similar earlier request), stale (a recent take is useful and a months-old one is not), none (offer nothing). Per case the F1 of the offered ids against the useful ids, equal weight on precision and recall, fixed before any arm was scored; a none case scores 1 for offering nothing. A case passes at F1 0.5. One number: the share of cases passed; details carry the mean F1 and the share per kind.
disadvantages: Invented cases: the hub holds no consumer's record of what a person kept, and a consumer's real takes would test the weights and the half-life; the number is accuracy only (no cost or time term, no balance table), which is honest while both arms are free and local.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arms that call no model were recorded on the same cases] > paid [sample=sample:10 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=a model arm beat the best free arm on the free stage and a person authorized the run]
command: esoi run intuition --impl nearest_cards; esoi run intuition --impl co_taken
